evidence.quote: thoroughly investigated with JWST/NIRCam photometry, NIRSpec-IFU spectroscopy, and ALMA data, uncovering their physical origins.

evidence.quote: indicating AGN activity with a low-mass black hole of $M_\mathrm{BH}\sim10^{6.6}~M_\odot$
It is worth noting that there are other possibilities of producing a broad H$\alpha$ emission line

claims.hypothesis: Do low-dust 'blue mergers' contrast with dusty 'red mergers' such as SMGs and help produce extended Lya?
claims.experiment: Compared dust, stellar and metal content of Himiko/CR7 with SMGs and dusty mergers, plus FOREVER22 Lya radiative transfer
claims.result: Himiko/CR7 are metal-poor, dust-poor and low-mass compared with dusty mergers
claims.finding: Blue mergers with extended gas are a key mechanism for extended Lya emission

evidence.quote: Blue mergers, such as Himiko and CR7, are characterized by low stellar mass, low dust mass, and low metallicity.

why_this_data.value: Public JWST data plus archival ALMA Band 6 to probe stellar, ionized and cold gas/dust content of two bright Lya objects

evidence.quote: We also include archival ALMA Band 6 data to examine their cold gas and dust characteristics.

why_this_method.value: A uv-tapered [CII] cube was used to optimize S/N for measuring the spatial distribution and flux

evidence.quote: We use the uv-tapered line cube to measure the spatial distributions and fluxes of \[C ii\]$158\ensuremath{\mu}m$ of Himiko and CR7.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: [CII] fluxes obtained by summing spectral bins rather than Gaussian fitting; Gaussian fit gives consistent results

evidence.quote: However, these flux values are largely consistent with the results obtained by least-squares fitting of a Gaussian.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: ALMA photometry excluded from SED fitting due to lower resolution and upper-limit-only continuum

evidence.quote: We do not include the ALMA photometry because the ALMA data have a lower resolution
Throughout this paper, we only show statistical errors.

limitations_admitted.value: Deeper dust continuum observations are needed to constrain dust-to-gas and dust-to-metal ratios

evidence.quote: We need deeper dust continuum observations aimed at Himiko and CR7 to constrain these properties.

limitations_admitted.value: Higher-resolution ALMA data needed for the Himiko [CII] distribution and kinematics

evidence.quote: Additional high-resolution ALMA data are necessary to comprehend the \[C ii\] distribution of Himiko

limitations_admitted.value: Gas mass estimates have large uncertainty

evidence.quote: The gas mass estimate has a large uncertainty

referee_caveats_inferred: The [CII] and Lya offset in Himiko is inferred from a ~0.9 arcsec ALMA beam and ~0.75 arcsec Subaru PSF versus JWST resolution, with ALMA astrometric uncertainty comparable to the 0.3 arcsec offset
Dust-mass limits depend on assumed T_dust (40 K, no CMB-dependent temperature evolution explored beyond 35-45 K), beta and kappa
Gas masses rely on a low-redshift-calibrated [CII]-H2 conversion and ignore HI, with ~0.3 dex scatter
Only the Cycle 1 Himiko data are recalibrated with Help Desk support; the older CASA versions may limit exact reproduction of flux scales
Mean metallicity and stellar masses from aperture photometry without aperture corrections may bias clump comparisons

data_public_as_stated.value: ALMA data retrieved from the public ALMA Science Archive; JWST data from MAST

evidence.quote: We retrieve these data from the ALMA Science Archive[^5].

products_in_archive.value: Calibration done with scripts in the archive

evidence.quote: using the calibration script or pipeline script in the archive

code_released.value: TEMPLATES JWST NIRSpec IFU reduction script is public (v1.0.2); no authors' ALMA analysis code stated

evidence.quote: The reduction procedure is coded in the script that is now publicly available (version 1.0.2; (cite: jane_rigby_2024_10933642))[^2].

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Three Band 6 projects (Cycle 0, Cycle 1 with 4 spectral windows over 7.5 GHz and 3.2 h, Cycle 3): likely tens of GB of raw/calibrated measurement sets
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA data are public and the main imaging choices (natural weighting, 0.1 arcsec, 50 km/s, 0.7 arcsec taper) and flux/dust-mass recipes are given with numeric results, but tclean parameters, apertures, continuum windows and recalibration details are missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public archival ALMA data, concise recipe for continuum limit, [CII] flux, L[CII] and dust/gas mass, and numeric results in Table 5 make the ALMA part redoable.
